authority: Measurement aid only. Does not authorize gear design, asset adoption, or renderer integration.
coordinateSystem: pixel coordinates, origin top-left, x right, y down, points are in each exported frame canvas before scene scaling
measurementMethod: Visual estimates read from state contact sheets overlaid with 32px coordinate grid; chest and paw positions have stated tolerance. No source pixels were edited. Exact alpha bounds and SHA-256 were measured from exported PNG files.

neckChestAnchor.interpretation: scarf-knot/pendant chest center; accessory may be obscured by baked-in scarf/pendant

primaryFrontPawAnchor.interpretation: rightmost visible forepaw/wrist center for gear placement; paw silhouette changes with pose

catalystEffectOriginCandidate.interpretation: provisional forward-offset from paw; effect art/gameplay not established

occlusion.bodyGear: scarf, pendant, torso and forelegs are baked into body frame; do not assume clean compositing slot
occlusion.pawGear: overlay should be in front of paw pixels; use mask cutout or accept overlap only after visual QA
occlusion.effect: render over body, preserve icon/projectile readability

coverage.walkFrameIndexRule: frameIndex/runtimeFrameIndex follow CharacterLocomotion.play paths.enumerated index; sourceFrameIndex is the PNG suffix/source atlas cell. Rejected source cell 1 is omitted from runtime array, so source frame 2 maps to runtime frame 1.

candidateEquipmentUse.bodySlot: chest/torso anchor only; baked scarf and pendant create occlusion conflict, so body armor overlay requires approved cutout/layer asset before production use
candidateEquipmentUse.handSlot: use per-frame primaryFrontPawAnchor as approximate attachment pivot; retain body alpha mask/foreground paw pixels
candidateEquipmentUse.feetSlot: use per-frame visible paw/toe geometry; current single paw anchor is not sufficient to independently anchor all four footwear pieces
candidateEquipmentUse.ringSlot: test at front paw anchor but validate species identity and readability; no ring mesh/art implied
candidateEquipmentUse.catalyst: effect origin is an unapproved forward offset from paw; root/renderer must decide whether familiar action originates at chest pendant or paw
